title: Source text masking
responsibility: Replaces comments and optional literal contents with spaces while retaining offsets, line breaks and template expressions for source analysis.

inputs.name: maskSource.code
inputs.description: JavaScript-like source text scanned when comment and literal masking must preserve source offsets. The scanner keeps total length and newlines, but recognizes regular expressions heuristically and only finds their closing slash on the same line.

inputs.name: maskSource.options
inputs.description: Defaults to `{}`; `options.strings ?? true` means omitted or nullish `strings` enables literal-content masking. Set `strings` to `false` to preserve single- and double-quoted, template, and recognized regular-expression contents while comments are still masked.

outputs.name: maskSource
outputs.description: The returned source has comments replaced by spaces while line breaks and total length are preserved. Literal delimiters remain, and template interpolation regions are scanned as code; literal contents are blanked by default and preserved when `strings` is `false`.
